title: fabric-vdr-core: an AnonCreds v2 Verifiable Data Registry chaincode for Hyperledger Fabric
description: Java chaincode for Hyperledger Fabric that implements a Verifiable Data Registry for AnonCreds v2, with a guarded revocation update that commits at most one of two mutually guarded revocations. This is the artifact of the TDK paper Decentralized verifiable credential revocation with atomic test-and-set for cross-organizational settings (Tibor Sinka, BME, 2026): the chaincode, its unit and end-to-end tests, the benchmark scripts, and the raw scalability and robustness results that the paper reports.
